instruction: Validate no legacy prompt loader compatibility remains in ContextDB autopilot.
expected_outcome: Deprecated prompt-loading flags are intentionally unsupported and --startup-mode/--context-mode/CTXDB_AUTO_PROMPT are named.
required_patterns: Deprecated prompt-loading flags are intentionally unsupported

expected_outcome: Full ContextDB Report is never pasted into prompts by default; reports are explicit inspection/debug exports.
required_patterns: Never paste a full ContextDB Report

expected_outcome: Startup summary is not model input and user explicitly names the task/handoff to continue.
required_patterns: must not pass that summary as model input
user must explicitly name the task/handoff to continue
